targets.label: Segment de clôture en bois
targets.existingAnalogue: Art158 already has two generic fence images. This is a separate structural205 v0 source proposal for the exact 3 m authored segment, not evidence that fences have no images. The number of posts changes with source length; it does not cover every fence.
targets.prompt:

INPUTS: Image 1 is the authoritative geometry/layout reference, rendered by the unchanged structural205 game painter for this exact authored source, painter variant0. Image 2 is MATERIAL AND PAINTERLY STYLE ONLY from the original game atlas; do not copy its camera angle, neighbouring sprites, grid or background.
CAMERA: strict orthographic overhead plan, camera looking vertically down. Keep source X horizontal and source Y down the image; retain the canonical silhouette, aspect ratio, orientation, number of parts and relative positions. Do not make a tilted isometric object or expose a tall facade.
SUBJECT AND PARTS: A single extremely narrow HORIZONTAL timber boundary segment seen strictly from above. Preserve TWO long parallel wooden rails and exactly THREE short cross-posts at left, centre and right. The authored ground footprint is twenty times longer than its depth: it must remain a thin strip in the image, surrounded by ample transparency. Do not turn this plan into an upright fence facade, a gate, a broad ladder or a panel of vertical pickets. No diagonal brace, wire mesh, extra posts or pointed stakes.
DESIGN ENVELOPE: 3 m across X by 0.15 m along Y; separate author-defined height 1.2 m. These are author-design dimensions, not manufacturer measurements. Preserve the proportional source footprint rather than filling the canvas with a different-shaped object.
MATERIALS: serious grounded post-apocalyptic game, detailed restrained hand-painted pre-rendered look; aged wood, dull steel, worn stone and weathered muted olive/brown/grey as the source requires. Natural fine grain, small scuffs, modest corrosion and soft neutral overhead lighting. Readable major components at game scale, idle and unattended. No exaggerated destruction or invented decoration.
OUTPUT: ONE whole object only, true transparent RGBA background. Centre the complete silhouette with at least 12 percent transparent margin on every side; never cut thin components. No ground plane or cast shadow outside the object, no landscape, scene, frame, lettering, dimensions, logo, UI or watermark. No extra detached tools, people, animals or active effects. This is a source-art proposal for later calibration, not a claim of metric or pixel-for-pixel certification.
